collection.name: sheetProfiles
collection.doc: 🪗 Trapezoidal profile of a cold-formed sheet (EN 1999-1-4 5.5, 6.1): one rib of two webs between a top and a bottom flange, so that the bending, shear and deflection checks use the profiled section instead of the flat strip.

fields.name: sheet_id
fields.doc: 🔗 Id of the cold-formed sheet that carries this profile; the sheet thickness is the profile thickness.

fields.name: pitch
fields.doc: ↔️ Pitch p [m] of one rib (top flange, web, bottom flange, web), measured between the mid-lines.

fields.name: top_flange
fields.doc: ⬜️ Flat width b_t [m] of the top flange between the web corners (mid-line).

fields.name: bottom_flange
fields.doc: ⬜️ Flat width b_b [m] of the bottom flange between the web corners (mid-line).

fields.name: web_height
fields.doc: ↕️ Vertical distance h [m] between the mid-lines of the flanges; the web inclination follows from the pitch and the flange widths.
